runtime.method: Two read-only snapshots of the 32-bit process globals: direct /proc/PID/mem read and a GDB memory dump. The conditional hardware breakpoint at 00487620 required EDX==2; it did not hit during the short observation interval. GDB was detached after interrupting its wait at a syscall.

limits: The four fields are reported in storage order; their semantic axis names are not inferred from this capture.
The mode-2 caller path was not observed; the breakpoint timeout does not prove that path is unreachable.
